Contents Introduction: Our Global Manufacturing Network
Our global factory network has been foundational to our success,
enabling product optimization, improved economics, and supply
resilience. We currently operate wafer manufacturing facilities in the
US (Oregon and Arizona), Ireland, and Israel, assembly and testing
facilities in Costa Rica, China, Malaysia, and Vietnam, and packaging
facilities in the US (New Mexico), Costa Rica, Vietnam, and Malaysia.
Our geographically distributed network of semiconductor manufacturing
facilities and assembly and test facilities allows us to produce advanced
semiconductor logic chips in high volume. After a process technology
node is developed by our technology development group, we seek to
shift production to one or more high-volume manufacturing facilities.
Maintaining reliable production capacity is of critical importance.
